error.bad_audio: Couldn't read the recording. Try another file.
error.bad_path: The app can't open this file. Pick it with Choose file.
error.bad_position: Couldn't jump to this point in the recording.
error.bad_speakers: Choose from 1 to 10 participants, or Not sure.
error.busy: Something is already being processed. Wait for it to finish.
error.export_failed: Couldn't prepare the file. Try again.
error.hotword_too_long: A word or phrase is longer than 64 characters. Shorten it.
error.import_failed: Couldn't open the file. Try another one.
error.llm_broken: The language model file is damaged. Load it again.
error.llm_busy: The language model is busy. Wait until it finishes.
error.llm_failed: Couldn't write the summary. Try again.
error.llm_load_failed: The language model didn't start. Restart the app.
error.llm_no_memory: Not enough memory. Close other apps and try again.
error.llm_not_found: The language model isn't on this phone.
error.llm_too_long: The meeting is too long to summarize.
error.mic_denied: No access to the microphone. Allow it in Android settings.
error.mic_unavailable: Another app is using the microphone. Close it and try again.
error.models_bad_manifest: Speech models are damaged. Reinstall the app.
error.models_corrupt: Speech models are damaged. Reinstall the app and download the models again.
error.models_download_corrupt: A model file arrived damaged. Try again.
error.models_download_failed: Couldn't download the models. Check your connection and try again.
error.models_incomplete: Speech models are not fully downloaded. Download them on the home screen.
error.models_load_failed: Speech models failed to start. Restart the app.
error.models_not_found: Speech models are not downloaded. Download them on the home screen.
error.models_storage_low: Not enough storage for the models. Free up space and try again.
error.name_control_chars: The name has characters that aren't allowed.
error.name_too_long: The name is longer than 64 characters. Shorten it.
error.no_audio: The original recording is gone, so it can't be played.
error.no_audio_track: This file has no audio. Choose another one.
error.no_speech: No speech found in the recording.
error.no_transcript: Transcript not found. Make a new recording.
error.no_voice_center: This transcript's voices weren't saved. Transcribe the recording again.
error.not_playing: The recording isn't open. Open the transcript again.
error.sample_too_short: Not enough speech in the recording. Ask for a couple more sentences.
error.save_failed: Couldn't save the file. Choose another location.
error.silent: The recording is too quiet to hear speech. Record again closer to the microphone.
error.storage_low: Not enough free storage: at least 200 MB is needed.
error.text_control_chars: The text has characters that aren't allowed.
error.text_too_long: The text is too long. Shorten it.
error.too_long: The recording is longer than 3 hours. Choose a shorter file.
error.too_many_hotwords: More than 100 words. Keep the ones you need most.
error.too_short: The recording is shorter than a second. Record a bit longer.
error.unknown_speaker: This participant is no longer in the transcript.
error.unknown_turn: This turn is no longer in the transcript.
error.unknown_voice: This voice is no longer saved.
error.unsupported_audio: This format isn't supported. Use m4a, mp3, wav, ogg or flac.
error.voice_name_taken: A voice with this name already exists.
